network_status.network: Accordo di programma per il rifacimento del ponte Cernera
network_status.summary_it: L'atto ufficiale collega il rifacimento del Ponte Cernera agli eventi alluvionali dell'8 settembre 2003, ma non pubblica livelli o portate alla sezione. Il riconoscimento amministrativo del danno non viene presentato come osservazione idrometrica.
network_status.summary_en: The official act links reconstruction of Ponte Cernera to the 8 September 2003 flood event but publishes no stage or discharge at the section. Administrative recognition of the damage is not presented as a hydrometric observation.

provenance.method: Manual extraction encoded in the ARCUS event-report curation registry

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
